name: Atende S.A.
summary: Atende S.A., a technology company established in 1991 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, specializes in integrating information technology systems and developing comprehensive information and communication technology (ICT) infrastructures across the country. The firm delivers a broad spectrum of ICT integration solutions, including the construction of computer networks and data centers, as well as the implementation of digital workplace environments. Additionally, it offers tailored IT security solutions for critical sectors like defense, telecommunications, energy, and finance. Atende's service portfolio extends to data center infrastructure management and diverse IT solutions. The company also provides cloud services, facilitating access to public clouds and supplying essential computing and storage resources. Furthermore, its expertise encompasses software and application development, alongside advanced services in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and the Internet of Things. While serving a wide range of industries, the power engineering sector represents a significant area of focus. The company operated under the name ATM Systemy Informatyczne S.A. until its rebranding to Atende S.A. in April 2013.
